summary: Fixed all 21 Pylance errors in gui_app.py. Changes: (1) Switched qfluentwidgets grouped import to individual lines with # type: ignore[assignment] on FluentWindow, PrimaryPushButton, SubtitleLabel, setTheme, setThemeColor, BodyLabel. (2) Added DARK=None to _FallbackTheme class. (3) Updated Qt enum namespacing for PySide6: AlignRight->AlignmentFlag.AlignRight, AlignCenter->AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter, UserRole->ItemDataRole.UserRole, KeepAspectRatio->AspectRatioMode.KeepAspectRatio, SmoothTransformation->TransformationMode.SmoothTransformation. (4) QLineEdit.Password->QLineEdit.EchoMode.Password. (5) Added isinstance guard for QApplication.instance().setStyleSheet. (6) Added # type: ignore[attr-defined] on sys.stdout/stderr.reconfigure. (7) Fixed _tm.get_theme(index)->get_theme(index=index). (8) Added python.analysis.extraPaths for vault-themes to .vscode/settings.json.
